units.title: SG-1.4 · Compact header overlay wired to the UI store with Tailwind layout tests
Act: Track round loading/error in App and render HeaderOverlay
units.failure: Act agent reported ok:false: Step 1 done: App.tsx now has roundError/roundLoading state and the getCurrentRound().then(setRound).catch(...).finally(...) effect exactly as specified. tsc --noEmit shows no errors in App.tsx; its only error is a pre-existing one in tests/tailwindConfig.test.ts. Step 2 is BLOCKED: HeaderOverlay does not exist in this branch (no file under game/frontend/src/components, no references in source or tests). It exists only on branch devion/exec-01m84knr (commit 7519c78), with props worldName/round/error (no loading), and it imports ../runtime/uiStore, which does not exist here (store is src/store/uiStore.ts). I did not port it, and I did not remove RoundBadge/Countdown, since that would drop the round display with nothing to replace it. Needed to unblock: create or merge HeaderOverlay into this branch with the props the brief names (worldTitle, round, loading, error), then apply Step 2. Pre-existing uncommitted change in components/GameLayout.tsx (header prop) was left untouched. Nothing committed. Baseline: scan v1, tip 9cda5131c65b08541fc685d8a0898d39a0e9e9fa.
